manual.redstone_state_cells.line2: A state cell is a component for use with {0}Redstone Wires{1}. They store an input value and will then output that same value until they are reset.{2}
manual.redstone_state_cells.line3: Where previously, such setups required multiple comparator blocks or even pistons, it's now possible to store the value in a single {0}electron tube{1}.{2}
manual.redstone_state_cells.line4: Using the Engineer's Screwdriver on the state cell opens the screen to configure its Set, Reset and Output signal colours.{0}
manual.redstone_state_cells.line5: §lSet: §rA signal of this colour is stored in the state cell until it is reset.
manual.redstone_state_cells.line6: §lReset: §rA signal of this colour resets the state cell, allowing it to be set again.
manual.redstone_state_cells.line7: §lOutput: §rThis is the signal colour the cell is outputting its value on.{0}
manual.redstone_state_cells.line8: When the Set and Reset signals are configured to the same colour, the state cell will work as a toggle system, where every time a pulse of that colour is received, the cell switches between having an output or having none.
